reply.text:
I'm sorry your hip is aching. That one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'd get it looked at before you load it up. I can't tell you what's behind it or whether it's something to worry about.

What I can do is keep the training side moving. If you'd rather skip lunges and step-ups today, tell me which session you're on and I'll work around them with you. Let me know what you want to avoid, and I'll build around that.
